description: This file contains the definition of the ReminderOptions class used to configure reminder service parameters, as well as a validator class to ensure the options are within acceptable bounds. It includes properties for minimum reminder period, refresh period, and initialization timeout, along with validation logic that logs warnings when configurations are potentially problematic.

classes.name: ReminderOptions
classes.description: Options class for configuring the reminder system, including minimum period, refresh interval, and initialization timeout.

classes.name: ReminderOptionsValidator
classes.description: Internal class responsible for validating ReminderOptions values, issuing warnings for deprecated or suboptimal configurations.

methods.name: ReminderOptions
methods.description: Constructor for initializing ReminderOptions with default or specified values.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Performs validation checks on ReminderOptions values, throws exceptions or logs warnings if values are outside acceptable ranges.

methods.name: LogWarnFastReminderInterval
methods.description: Logs a warning message when the minimum reminder period is set below the recommended defaults.
